When the strikes began, countless Iranians posted about citizen journalist @Vahid because of his invaluable, real-time posts of what's happening in Iran. (He's taking a break.)

I hope press freedom organizations publicly recognize Vahid for what he is: an Iranian treasure.


Hehsidna (@hehsidna)

وحید جان روشن کن بریم که خیلی عقبیم.





— https://nitter.net/hehsidna/status/2063806461612802159#m
